title: Premium Percentile Base Fee Target
description: Replacing the utilization-based base fee adjustment with a premium-based target will stabilize gas markets and improve tipset efficiency, aligning base fee adjustments with congestion signals to reduce proposer duplications.

storageProviders: Should review gas price configurations, such as premium floors, that may have been tuned for a negligible base fee.
clients: Because the base fee will rise more often than before, an insufficient gas fee cap may delay message inclusion.
tokenHolders: Higher base fees reduce net inflation through increased burn.
applicationDevelopers: Dashboards, economic models, and pricing tools that assume current base fee behavior will need to be updated.
Systems recommending gas prices to transactors SHOULD be updated.
